acceptanceCriteria.text: Header icon opens an accessible Mail dialog with reward details/item names/icons, expiry/remaining time, known/unknown/empty states and explicit refresh.
Single/all mail claims and existing report reward access use exact supported RPCs; queued/failed/uncertain claims do not optimistically credit rewards, repeat, or leak across accounts.

Expired availableUntil-second mail and expiresAt-millisecond reports are removed from canonical/raw caches and header counts automatically; unknown expiry stays, and fresh snapshots supersede stale/claimed data safely.
Capture-shaped parsing/pruning, actual UI and background claim lifecycle, Direct/Piggyback and real Chrome regressions plus full tests/typecheck/build pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Header mail icon should open a dialog showing cached mail rewards, deadline and claim controls. Reuse existing mailFarm/report claims under shared RPC policy; prune only explicit expired mail/report deadlines from cache, keep unknown deadlines, and retain accurate account-scoped server-confirmed claim state.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Verify captured mail/report fields, existing reward parser/assets, claim contract and cache merge/pruning. 2. Add shared mail model/expiry helpers and account-safe prune/receipt/snapshot reduction plus background expiry scheduling and claim ownership. 3. Build reward-first Mail dialog, single/all/report claim actions and header/modal wiring; no auto-claim on opening. 4. Test deadline units, raw/canonical cleanup, snapshot precedence, unknown/expired/claimed rows, UI and exact claim pending/error/account paths. 5. Verify real Chrome Direct/Piggyback, run full checks/build and document contract/decision impact.
checkpointPayload.title: Add reward-first mail dialog and expire cached inbox entries
